macros.name: appendix
macros.doc: Starts the appendix in the specified modes. All frames, all \subsection commands, and all \section commands used after this command will not be shown as part of the normal navigation bars.

macros.name: AtBeginLecture
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every lecture.

macros.name: AtBeginPart
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every part.

macros.name: AtBeginSection
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every section. If the ⟨special star text⟩ parameter is specified, this text will be used for starred sections instead.

macros.name: AtBeginSection
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every section. If the ⟨special star text⟩ parameter is specified, this text will be used for starred sections instead.

macros.name: AtBeginSubsection
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every subsection. If the ⟨special star text⟩ parameter is specified, this text will be used for starred subsections instead.

macros.name: AtBeginSubsection
macros.doc: The given text will be inserted at the beginning of every subsection. If the ⟨special star text⟩ parameter is specified, this text will be used for starred subsections instead.

macros.name: breakhere
macros.doc: In order to create a line break in the table of contents (usually not a good idea), you can use the command \breakhere.

macros.name: includeonlylecture
macros.doc: Causes all \frame, frame, \section, \subsection, and \part commands following a \lecture command to be suppressed, except if the lecture’s label matches the ⟨lecture label⟩.

macros.name: insertpart
macros.doc: \insertpart inserts the current part name. • \insertpartnumber inserts the current part number as an Arabic number into a template. • \insertromanpartnumber inserts the current part number as a Roman number into a template.

macros.name: insertshortlecture
macros.doc: The ⟨short lecture name⟩ is available via the \insertshortlecture command.

macros.name: insertshortlecture
macros.doc: The ⟨short lecture name⟩ is available via the \insertshortlecture command.

macros.name: lecture
macros.doc: The \lecture command makes it easy to select only a certain set of frames from a file to be presented.

macros.name: lecture
macros.doc: The \lecture command makes it easy to select only a certain set of frames from a file to be presented.

macros.name: part
macros.doc: To create a new part, use the \part command. All sections and subsections following this command will be “local” to that part.

macros.name: part
macros.doc: To create a new part, use the \part command. All sections and subsections following this command will be “local” to that part.
